connector.name: Timebook
connector.registryDescription: Track time on usetimebook.com - start/stop timers, log entries, list projects/clients.
connector.summary: Hosted at usetimebook.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package timebook. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the squidcode account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: TIMEBOOK_API_URL
env.description: Override the Timebook API base URL. Defaults to https://usetimebook.com.

env.name: TIMEBOOK_WEB_URL
env.description: Override the Timebook web URL used during `timebook login`. Defaults to https://usetimebook.com.
